Name: NoobBerries
Author: scrotorrr
Description: Nothing fancy going on here.  My farmer Sherry was running around hungry and I wanted to make sure she was taken care of.  Now, she's NoobBerry Sherry!  With every fruit bush on the map 100% guaranteed to bear NoobBerries from Spring 1-14, you won't go hungry again!  Compatible with every map I've played with including East Scarp, Ridgeside Village, SVE, Walk to the Desert, and my custom farm type Orchard Farm (coming soon).  Also works with Auto Forager.

Manifest.Name: NoobBerry Bushes
Manifest.Description: Puts fruit on the fruit bushes during the first 14 days of Spring.
